premise: The sun goes down, each thing in the forest says goodnight in its own way, and the moon keeps watch.
inspiration: The goodnight litany of folk lullabies, which name each thing in turn; turned so that the night itself has friends who keep watch.
lesson: Night is a safe, kind time, watched over by friends.

en-US.title: The Forest Goes to Sleep
en-US.text: {firefly:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunset 0.8 26s} [softly] The sun is going down behind the hills, and the whole forest turns orange and pink. Time for bed. A little {mushroom:enter} mushroom pops up in the grass. She {mushroom:pulse} tucks herself under her cap. {mushroom:face sleeping} Goodnight, mushroom. {canvas:night 0.8 45s} Now the sky is deep blue, and here comes the moon, round and kind. {sfx:crickets} Cri-cri, sing the crickets, cri-cri. A {firefly:enter} {firefly:face happy} firefly comes flying by, zig-zag, zig-zag. She {firefly:live hold} closes her eyes and glows brighter and brighter, like a little lantern. {firefly:glow} Goodnight, firefly. {sfx:owl-hoot solo} Down flies the {owl:enter} owl, onto a high branch. He {owl:live} blinks. He looks around. He yawns… and nods off! Then one eye opens. Then the other. [whispers] {owl:face happy} Don't worry, he says. The moon and I will keep watch. The firefly {firefly:live resume} dims her light and blinks, twice. {all:face sleeping} [yawns] Goodnight, forest. {owl:face happy} Goodnight.

es-ES.title: El bosque se va a dormir
es-ES.text: {firefly:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunset 0.8 26s} [softly] El sol se esconde detrás de las colinas, y todo el bosque se vuelve naranja y rosa. Hora de dormir. Una {mushroom:enter} setita asoma entre la hierba. {mushroom:pulse} Se arropa bajo su sombrero. {mushroom:face sleeping} Buenas noches, seta. {canvas:night 0.8 45s} Ahora el cielo es azul oscuro, y aquí llega la luna, redonda y buena. {sfx:crickets} Cri-cri, cantan los grillos, cri-cri. Pasa volando una {firefly:enter} {firefly:face happy} luciérnaga, zigzag, zigzag. {firefly:live hold} Cierra los ojos y brilla más y más, como un farolillo. {firefly:glow} Buenas noches, luciérnaga. {sfx:owl-hoot solo} El {owl:enter} búho baja volando a una rama alta. {owl:live} Parpadea. Mira alrededor. Bosteza… ¡y se queda dormido! Luego abre un ojo. Luego el otro. [whispers] {owl:face happy} No os preocupéis, dice. La luna y yo vigilamos. La luciérnaga {firefly:live resume} baja su lucecita y parpadea dos veces. {all:face sleeping} [yawns] Buenas noches, bosque. {owl:face happy} Buenas noches.

crickets.prompt: soft summer night crickets chirping gently far away

owl-hoot.prompt: one soft, warm, distant owl hoot, hoo-hoo, calm and friendly
